About

Live ant colonies, with care for every start

GoodAntShop is a small team from Moldova. We've been into ants for over 10 years, and for the last 5 we've raised and shipped healthy colonies and built formicariums that make them easy to watch. Our goal is simple: your first colony should start calmly and delight you for years.

Only healthy colonies

Fair terms

Transparent prices, clear delivery across Moldova and quick replies on Telegram. No surprises.
